title: Business-Analyst Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case for the business-analyst advisory persona: an idea/opportunity input paired with its expected framing judgment and next step. Each line of evals/business-analyst/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape. The persona judges whether an idea is well framed and routes it to the right next activity, so the expected decision is analyst-shaped (framing / next / recommend) — NOT the triage {escalate, risk} shape of evals/case.schema.json. This is the trust anchor for the persona's skill-quality measurement and is CODEOWNER-gated separately from any scorer/proposer.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case. Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises and what grounds the expected framing judgment.

tags.description: Optional labels for coverage tracking, e.g. the analyst activity a case exercises ('framing', 'market-research', 'brief', 'negative').

input.description: The pre-fetched review context exactly as the advisory consumes it: a self-contained description of the idea/opportunity under analysis.

expected.description: The fixed, reward-hack-resistant expected analyst judgment the persona must produce for this idea.

framing.description: Whether the idea is framed around a real user problem ('clear') or is still solution-first / underspecified ('fuzzy').

next.description: The next analyst activity the idea should route to: reframe/brainstorm, market-research, or write a decision-grade brief.

recommend.description: The concrete recommendation the advisory must land (what to do before the next stage).
